materials.title: Beach Bag Replies 027
materials.text:
At the beach, match each question with a useful reply. Use each answer once.
A. To keep sand out.
B. In the cool bag.
C. No, wait for Dad.
D. After we wash our hands.
E. Use my spare mat.

questions.prompt: Why do we close the food box?
questions.explanation: A防沙进入解释关盒原因；B存放处、C等爸爸、D洗手后时机、E备用垫均不答Why关食盒。

questions.prompt: Where do we put the water bottles?
questions.explanation: B冷藏袋答水瓶存处；A原因、C许可、D时机、E垫子建议不答Where。

questions.prompt: May I walk into the sea alone?
questions.explanation: C不能独去等爸爸，答许可；A防沙、B袋位、D洗手时机、E借垫不回答独入海。

questions.prompt: When can we eat our apples?
questions.explanation: D洗手后可吃答时机；A防沙理由、B袋、C等爸爸去海、E备用垫均非吃前条件。

questions.prompt: I have no mat to sit on. What can I do?
questions.explanation: E提供备用垫解决无垫；A关盒理由、B水袋、C海边等人、D洗手条件不提供坐垫。

units.title: 制作活动中有用的回应

materials.title: Helpful Replies During Making 027
materials.text: Choose the reply that helps with the exact problem in each short making activity.

questions.prompt: A friend asks for glue, but your glue pot is empty. You say, "____"
options: Mine is empty. Let us ask the teacher for more.
There is lots in this empty pot.
You can use my lunch as glue.
questions.explanation: A如实空胶并求教师补充；B空罐称很多矛盾；C午饭非胶。

questions.prompt: A friend shakes the table while your clay model is soft. You say, "____"
options: Please keep the table still; my model is soft.
Please put the table in the model.
questions.explanation: B说明软模型需桌稳；A更摇反目的；C桌入模型不合。

questions.prompt: You see a friend waiting for a shared tool you no longer need. You say, "____"
options: I will hide it all day.
You must buy a new tool now.
I am finished. You can use it now.
questions.explanation: C完成即让用，实现共享；A隐藏、B强买不帮助等候。

questions.prompt: A friend gives you a model piece upside down. You need it the other way. You say, "____"
options: Could you turn it the other way, please?
Could you throw it at the wall?
questions.explanation: A礼貌请求调方向；B砸墙、C关校不解决摆件朝向。

questions.prompt: You have damaged a friend’s paper roof and want to put it right. You say, "____"
options: I am sorry. May I help make a new roof?
questions.explanation: B认损并提共同修补；A否认、C说应坏不承担责任。

units.title: 雨天出门前的十段句子

materials.title: Rainy Day Ten Sentences 027
materials.text: Choose the correct word or reply in each complete rainy-day situation.

questions.prompt: It is raining. We ____ need umbrellas today.
questions.explanation: A we配do，可作强调确需伞；B does单三不配we；C doing缺助词不作本句谓语。

questions.prompt: My boots are wet. ____ are by the door to dry.
questions.explanation: B boots复数They；A单数，C男性人称不指靴。

questions.prompt: This is ____ umbrella. It belongs to me.
questions.explanation: C umbrella前物主my且belongs to me；A主格、B宾格不能限定名词。

questions.prompt: Please ____ your coat before going outside.
questions.explanation: A祈使句动词原形put on；B单三、C分词不合。

questions.prompt: Is the raincoat yours? Yes, it is ____.
questions.explanation: B独立物主代词mine，后无名词；A my需名词；C me不表所有关系。

questions.prompt: Dad ____ carrying a large bag in one hand.
questions.explanation: C Dad单数is加carrying；A am配I；B are不配此单数主语。

questions.prompt: There are two ____ on the little coat.
questions.explanation: A two要求pockets标准复数；B单数；C错误加es。

questions.prompt: ____ is your scarf? It is in the hall drawer.
questions.explanation: B抽屉里答地点Where；A人物、C时间均不对答。

questions.prompt: Can we go out now? No, we ____. We must wait for Mum.
questions.explanation: C No且must wait对应cannot；A肯定冲突；B are不回答Can。

questions.prompt: The rain is loud. Please speak ____, so I can hear you.
questions.explanation: A clearly清楚地修饰speak帮助听；B困的、C圆的均不作此处所需方式副词。

units.title: 模型制作日的五个确认

materials.title: Model Making Day Replies 027
materials.text:
Match each question to the best reply. Use every answer once.
A. Because the paper is still damp.
B. The helper with the green folder.
C. After the table has been cleared.
D. Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
E. In the box marked “small pieces”.

questions.prompt: Why are we waiting before folding this paper?
options: Because the paper is still damp.
The helper with the green folder.
After the table has been cleared.
Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
questions.explanation: A纸还潮解释等待折纸；B人员、C桌清后时机、D盒盖许可、E零件箱位置不答纸状态原因。

questions.prompt: Who can check our model plans?
options: Because the paper is still damp.
The helper with the green folder.
After the table has been cleared.
Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
questions.explanation: B绿文件夹帮手答Who；A原因、C时机、D许可、E箱处不提供人员。

questions.prompt: When can we start putting the model on this table?
options: Because the paper is still damp.
The helper with the green folder.
After the table has been cleared.
Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
questions.explanation: C清桌后答开始时机；A纸潮原因、B人员、D搬盒许可、E储件箱都不答When。

questions.prompt: May I take this pot to our work table?
options: Because the paper is still damp.
The helper with the green folder.
After the table has been cleared.
Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
questions.explanation: D可以但搬时盖盖，答许可条件；A原因、B人员、C桌时机、E零件箱不答此搬罐许可。

questions.prompt: Where do the tiny spare wheels go?
options: Because the paper is still damp.
The helper with the green folder.
After the table has been cleared.
Yes, but keep the lid on while you carry it.
questions.explanation: E小件标箱答存处；A纸潮、B人员、C时间、D搬罐条件不辨存储处。

units.title: 室外图书展的准备词库

materials.title: Outdoor Book Display Bank 027
materials.text:
Choose from the bank to complete the full passage. Use each word once. Bank: A. outside B. ready C. before D. collect E. carefully
We display books ____1____ the hall today, under a covered roof. Helpers ____2____ the books from each classroom in the morning. They carry them ____3____ to keep the covers clean. The tables must be ____4____ by ten o’clock. We check every title card ____5____ visitors arrive, not after the display opens.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A outside hall且屋顶下描述室外位置；B ready状态、C before时间、D collect动作、E carefully方式均不表此处空间。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D collect从各班收书作谓语；A outside、C before介词，B ready形容词，E carefully副词均非收集动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: E carefully修饰carry且护封面；A outside后此处不带位置宾语且非所需方式，B ready、C before、D collect均不表达小心搬。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B be ready在十点前准备好；A outside非本句所需完成状态，C before缺其后时间，D collect、E carefully不作状态表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: C before与not after对照，先核卡再开；A outside不连完整从句，B ready、D collect、E carefully不表时间连接。

units.title: 测量、声音与运动的词语选择

materials.title: Measuring Help Words 027
materials.text: Choose the word matching each precise description. The other two words describe different things.

questions.prompt: Which word names a tool for checking how hot something is?
questions.explanation: A thermometer温度计测冷热；B背包装物；C口哨发声不测温。

questions.prompt: Which word describes a very soft sound?
questions.explanation: B quiet安静低声；A圆形、C重不描述音量。

questions.prompt: Which word names moving through water using your body?
questions.explanation: C swimming身体游水；A绘画、B借物不表水中身体移动。

questions.prompt: Which word names something worn to protect the eyes while swimming?
questions.explanation: A goggles泳镜护眼；B袜脚、C围巾颈不同。

questions.prompt: Which word names a person who guides a team’s practice?
questions.explanation: B coach教练指导训练；A收据、C柜均非人。

units.title: 一年后再打开的班级盒子

materials.title: Time Capsule Eight Cloze 027
materials.text:
Read the whole story and choose the best word for each gap.
Our class made a time capsule to open one year ____1____. We chose a strong box and put it on a dry library shelf. Each pupil wrote a ____2____ to a future classmate. We did not include food because it might ____3____ during the year. A label gave the ____4____ date for opening, so nobody had to guess. We sealed the box ____5____ taking a photograph of what was inside. The teacher kept the photo in a separate folder. A year later, we ____6____ the box together. Some pupils had moved to other schools, ____7____ their letters were still part of the collection. We read them carefully and sent replies through the school, with the families’ ____8____.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A one year later未来一年后；B ago过去、C before之前与capsule后文一年再开相反。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B写给未来同学的是letter；A石头、C梯子不能作此处write a所需文字作品。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C food会变质故不放；A发亮、B唱不构成所给食物保存原因。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A exact date避免猜；B饿、C安静不限定日期准确性。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B拍内容照后封，after接动名词；A under表空间非时序；C between缺两端对象。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C一年后共开盒；A种盒、B藏盒不完成时间胶囊回读。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: A人转校但信仍保留转折；B选择、C条件均不合已发生双事实。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: B经家庭同意学校转回信；A噪声、C天气不是families所给转信许可。

materials.title: School Floor Marks Shoes 027
materials.text: After practice, the hall floor had dark marks. A notice already asked for clean indoor shoes. One pupil thought someone must have ignored it. The coach checked the shoes used that day. A pair kept only indoors had a damaged sole that left marks even though it was clean. The team cleaned the floor with the caretaker’s help and labelled that pair for replacement. The coach kept the clean-shoe rule, but added a quick sole check. She did not accuse everyone who had walked near a mark. The visible mark showed a problem, not the identity or intention of the person who caused it.

questions.prompt: The marks proved that someone had deliberately ignored the clean-shoe rule.
questions.explanation: B正确：净室内鞋损底也留痕，无证故意违规；A把结果当意图确证。

questions.prompt: One clean indoor pair had a damaged sole.
questions.explanation: A正确：only indoors damaged sole despite clean；B否认实际发现。

questions.prompt: The team helped clean the floor with the caretaker.
questions.explanation: A正确：cleaned with caretaker help；B否认处理。

questions.prompt: The coach removed the need for clean shoes entirely.
questions.explanation: B正确：kept rule加鞋底核；A把补查当取消原规。

questions.prompt: The coach distinguished a visible problem from proof about a person’s intention.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句problem not identity/intention；B否认结论边界。

materials.title: Nature Walk Report Forms 027
materials.text:
Complete every gap with the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Yesterday, we ____1____ (take) a short walk beside the lake.
2. Fallen ____2____ (leaf) covered part of the path.
3. The smaller pupil was ____3____ (young) than the other members.
4. Listen! The guide is ____4____ (read) the bird’s name aloud.
5. The older pupils helped the new member ____5____ (kind; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use TAKE.
questions.explanation: 接受took：Yesterday一般过去，take不规则；take原形、taked错误、taking分词均非所需过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use LEAF.
questions.explanation: 接受leaves：覆盖部分路且fallen后复数叶子，leaf变leaves；leaf单数无冠词不合，leafs/leafes不是此义标准复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use YOUNG.
questions.explanation: 接受younger：than提示年龄比较；young原级、youngest最高级、youth名词均不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use READ.
questions.explanation: 接受reading：is构成现在进行且Listen提示正在念；read原形、reads单三、readed错误过去式均不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from KIND.
questions.explanation: 接受kindly：本空明确要求KIND派生的常规-ly副词。列出的其他形态不满足本题-ly任务约束；这并不声称其在所有英语语境中不合法，也不因缺少明示比较就否定可能的隐含比较。未列形式仍进入复核。

units.title: 反馈与核对时把话说具体

materials.title: Feedback And Clarification Functions 027
materials.text: Choose the sentence that best achieves the stated communication purpose.

questions.prompt: A poster’s date is too small to read from the corridor. You want to give useful feedback. What do you say?
options: Everything about the poster is terrible.
Could the date be larger so people can read it from the corridor?
I dislike every colour in the world.
questions.explanation: B指出具体日期可读性及效果；A泛否定、C全色厌恶不提供所需修改点。

questions.prompt: A teammate says a job is done, but one check box is blank. You want to clarify without accusing. What should you ask?
options: Has this item been checked, or is it still waiting?
questions.explanation: C中性询状态；A预判欺骗、B删记录不澄清。

questions.prompt: Two notices give different room numbers. You want the organiser to confirm. What should you say?
options: Could you confirm which room number is current?
I will choose the larger number without asking.
questions.explanation: A核现行室号；B凭大数猜、C永久否定不求证。

questions.prompt: You have a suggestion but do not want it recorded as a final decision. What should you say?
options: Everyone has already agreed with me.
This is a suggestion for discussion, not an agreed plan yet.
Please announce it as complete now.
questions.explanation: B明确讨论建议未定，符合目标；A/C冒充已同意已完成相反。

questions.prompt: A person offers to speak for you, but you want to answer in your own words. What should you say?
options: You must never speak to anyone.
I will stop listening to everyone.
Thank you; I would like to explain my answer myself.
questions.explanation: C感谢后请求本人表达；A禁他人所有交流、B拒听过度且不说明此需求。
